name: print-social-post-bold-red-brand-growth-tips-list
title: Red Instagram carousel post with pill-shaped tip list
whatItIs: A square social post on a flat red background with a heavy condensed headline and five black pill-shaped buttons listing brand-growth tips.
whatItMeans: Oversized type and stark black/white/red contrast make the advice legible and scroll-stopping without any imagery or icons.
techniques: stack information in pill-shaped bars for instant scannability
use one saturated background color as the entire visual identity
let a condensed, heavy display font do the attention-grabbing work

vocabulary.definition: a fully rounded rectangle button commonly used to contain short list items or tags
